extracted.intended_audience: early-career researchers and academic staff interested in SNSF Ambizione grants (Switzerland and abroad)
extracted.subtask_description: Informational summary of the SNSF Ambizione funding scheme: who may apply, the scheme's purpose, evaluation process, funding levels, typical project duration, and disciplinary scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Academic staff at all higher education institutions can apply; researchers whose salaries are fully covered by their institution may apply for project funds only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The scheme has supported promising early-career researchers from Switzerland and abroad since 2008. This eligibility wording implies both salaried academic staff and externally employed researchers may be applicants, but those fully salaried by their institution are limited to requesting project funds (not salary support).

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose — independent first project
rubrics_metrics.description: Grants enable researchers to conduct, manage and lead their first independent project at a higher education institution or other institution in Switzerland.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program is explicitly aimed at enabling early-career researchers to establish independence and advance their careers decisively; successful proposals should be structured as a first independent research project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation process — two-step selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are assessed via a two-step evaluation process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example cohort statistics: in 2023, 490 researchers submitted applications, 188 were selected for the second phase of evaluation, and 92 grants were ultimately awarded. This indicates a preliminary screening followed by a more selective second stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gender/diversity target
rubrics_metrics.description: Target of 35 per cent female awardees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The 35% female awardee target is a stated program aim; in the cited round the target was exceeded (46 grants, 50% to women). This indicates the SNSF monitors and sets targets for gender balance among awardees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding amount and total budget
rubrics_metrics.description: The SNSF is distributing a total of 75.7 million francs for the awarded grants; on average each awarded researcher receives 820,000 francs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should plan projects consistent with multi-hundred-thousand-franc budgets; the program funding level is substantial and intended to support a complete independent project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project start timing and duration
rubrics_metrics.description: Most of the projects will start in autumn 2024 and generally have a duration of four years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Successful proposals should be structured for approximately a four-year project period with expected start windows aligned to the program's announcement cycle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disciplinary scope / thematic breadth
rubrics_metrics.description: Selected projects span mathematics, informatics, natural sciences and technology (38%), social sciences and humanities (37%) and life sciences (25%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Ambizione scheme supports a wide range of research topics across STEM, social sciences, humanities, and life sciences — applicants from diverse disciplines are eligible and competitive representation is expected across fields.
